page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre with the year, page number at top right. Signature "F 3" at foot centre, catchword "conce" at foot right.

main_text.p: membra sint necessaria: Multo minus primum ob eandem rationem concedi poteft, præfertim cum scriptum illud Episcoporum, ad Synodum sit destinatum, ibique prælegendum, quod vel cæcis conspicuum est, fieri non posse, quin prius synodi ipsius membra constituantur: quibus constitutis, utrumque se facturos spondent synodici. At contra utrumque tanquam injustum protestatur Deputatus regius: Consensit tamen tandem in Præsidis electionem, protestatione prius præmissa, Electione hac nihil derogatum iuri prærogativæ regiæ, legibus & consuetudinibus receptis, nec dignitati & authoritati Episcoporum, quibus Moderationis honor competit. Respondent Synodici; Sibi nunquam statutum jus regium aut legum vim diminuere; Quod vero ad Episcopos illos attinet, habendos pro reis quoad de ipsorum innocentia constiterit; Addebant alii vel eo nomine reos esse, quod prærogativa præsidentiæ per fas & nefas sibi arripuerint. Tandem ad Præsidis electionem ventum est, potioreque suffragiorum numero eligitur Alexander Hendersonus, pastor Ecclesiæ Leucherensis in Classe Andreapolitana: Deputatus interim in suffragio ferendo ita se gerebat, quasi electionem permitteret, ad eamque conniveret potius quam directe ratam haberet. Provinciam eleganti oratione ac ardentibus precibus capessit novus Præses.

Posthæc Deputatus regius monet, Regem per literas nominasse sex senatores regni, omnes fere nobiles, quibus tanquam suis assessoribus, Ius suffragii definitivi competeret. Responsum à Præside; Regem in publicis fidei literis à Marchione prolatis, nullam fecisse assessorum quorumlibet mentionem, provinciam deputationis soli Marchioni commendasse; rem esse pessimi exempli quæ plurima incommoda secum traheret, si assessoribus jus illud definitivi suffragii conce

page.notes: Running head reads "IN REGNO SCOTIÆ." with the year 1638 printed between it and the page number. The catchword "conce" is the start of the next page's first word. Some letters at the left edge are stains or show-through and were not transcribed. Words such as "Præsidis" and "Hendersonus" are clear, but the spelling of the place name "Leucherensis" and the printed "Præfes" are read as printed and not checked against other sources.
